title: nginx-markdown-for-agents Dynamic Configuration Schema v1
description: JSON Schema for the dynconf runtime-reloadable configuration file. Only genuinely runtime-mutable keys are accepted.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. Must be exactly 1.

filter.description: Master on/off switch for Markdown conversion.

streaming_buffer.description: Streaming buffer size in bytes. Must be an integer; size strings are not accepted.
